jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Are you a strategic communicator who loves turning complex ideas into clear, compelling stories? As a Strategic Communication Consultant supporting HR, Law, Compliance and more, you’ll help shape how employees experience some of the most important moments in their careers at MassMutual.

In this role, you'll partner with leaders across Human Resources, Law and our corporate functions to develop and execute communication strategies that drive employee understanding, build trust, and foster engagement. Whether you're working on compensation, performance management, talent development, benefits, company policies or enterprise initiatives, you'll turn complex information into clear, meaningful communications.

This role blends strategic thinking, storytelling, and project management. You'll serve as a trusted advisor to business partners, shaping messaging, anticipating employee questions, and identifying connections across the organization. The ideal candidate is someone with strong judgment, exceptional writing and planning skills, and the ability to move easily between strategy and execution. Someone who is naturally curious, collaborative, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

Alongside a team of talented colleagues, you'll have the opportunity to influence some of our most important employee experiences while continuing to grow your own skills and career. And you'll be part of a company that's helping people secure their future and protect the ones they love – which starts with our employees.

The Team

The HR & Enterprise Communications team helps employees navigate some of the most important moments in their careers at MassMutual. Working closely with leaders and subject matter experts, we translate complex topics into communications that re clear and actionable. With everything we do, we strive to help employees understand what matters to them, connect their work to the company's direction, and build trust through timely, transparent communication.

The Impact

• Inform, engage, connect and inspire MassMutual employees through clear, straightforward communications that enhance the overall employee experience.
• Serve as a trusted communications advisor to leaders across our corporate functions, developing employee-centered communication strategies, and making connections across various initiatives to our broader strategy.
• Lead or support communications related to the employee experience, such as compensation, performance management, talent development, benefits, company policies, and more.
• Develop compelling content across a variety of channels, including presentations, intranet articles, email, video, digital displays, and more.
• Manage multiple projects simultaneously, balancing priorities while ensuring high-quality execution and delivery.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or higher in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations, Marketing, or a related field.
• 8+ years of communications experience - including communication strategy, project management and content creation with the ability translate complex information into clear compelling messages
• 3+ years’ experience developing and executing employee communications that drive engagement, understanding, and alignment with business priorities.

Ideal Qualifications

• Passion for employee communications and creating engaging, meaningful employee experiences.
• Demonstrated success advising senior leaders and influencing stakeholders while building strong collaborative relationships across all levels of an organization.
• Experience managing multiple projects, competing priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
• Proven success leading executive-level all-employee meetings, company-wide communication events, and large-scale communication initiatives.
• Strong visual storytelling capabilities, including the effective use of graphics, photography, video, presentations, and other multimedia formats to enhance communication impact.
• Experience using artificial intelligence tools, including Microsoft Copilot, to improve communication planning, content development, and execution.
• Knowledge of communication measurement, employee engagement, and change communication practices, with a commitment to continuously improving communication effectiveness through innovation and best practices.
• Ability to partner effectively with leaders, subject matter experts, designers, publishers, and other stakeholders to manage the end-to-end development and delivery of employee communications.

What You Can Expect at MassMutual

• MassMutual offers the opportunity to do meaningful work within a purpose-driven organization that values long-term impact over short-term outcomes. In this role, you can expect:
• Clear areas of ownership and accountability, with work that connects directly to company and customer outcomes.
• A collaborative environment where perspectives are welcomed.
• Access to learning, development, and internal networks that support continuous growth and skill-building over time.
• Employee-led communities and forums that foster connection, learning, and inclusion across the organization.
• A culture grounded in integrity, responsibility, and stewardship, supported by a company with a strong legacy and a future-focused mindset.

MassMutual is an equal employment opportunity employer. We welcome all persons to apply.

If you need an accommodation to complete the application process, please contact us and share the specifics of the assistance you need.

California residents: For detailed information about your rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), please visit our California Consumer Privacy Act Disclosures page.

jobs.description: INSLP (Security & Loss Prevention) is hiring an SLP Specialist to support growth of the “SLP MDR Concessions Abuse Program” and help preventing losses via identification of abusive entity. The program is aimed at identifying and eliminating Concessions Abuse while preserving customer trust. The primary objective of the SLP Specialist is to provide security services, investigation and asset protection in designated area of responsibility, assist in mitigating product loss, and maintain customer satisfaction in accordance with INSLP guidelines and policies. The role is cross-functional and requires deep collaboration and influencing ability with stakeholders from business and corporate functions. SLP Specialist's day-to-day activities involve planning, organizing, coordinating, implementing and executing process and procedures laid down by the organization and the SLP function. As a part of the SLP MDR Concessions Abuse program, the SLP Specialist is required to deep dive into the Concessions request raised by customer, and conduct end-to-end investigation across customer, DA/network and seller to identify the abusive entity. SLP has outlined frameworks for investigation, and the SLP Specialist is bound to adhere to the investigation guidelines. Along with primarily supporting on Concessions investigations, the SLP Specialist will be required to provide on-ground intel useful in uncovering abuse MOs. In order to ensure network integrity, the SLP Specialist will be required to conduct risk assessment and process audit for the respective sites and work in accordance with the security policies and guidelines. Key job responsibilities Security Operation • Implementation and follow-up of Loss Prevention Plan in MDR Concessions Audits and Compliance • Conducting SLP audits and implementing SOPs • Surprise check and reports at LM (Last Mile) stations • Keeping the plans and SOPs updated • Periodical check of documentation • Adhering to SLAs defined for the SLP MDR Concessions Abuse Program Process Improvement and Loss Prevention • Process review, gap analysis and implementation of necessary improvements • Weekly, monthly and quarterly assessments • Loss prevention reporting • Working on feedbacks received from internal and external stakeholders • Follow up and completion of CAPA • Recommending loss prevention initiatives based on on-ground intel Loss Prevention Analysis and Investigation • Work closely with the SLP and CS teams to analyze the loss trends in MDR Concessions • Weekly loss trend analysis, identifying defects / abusive entities and working towards loss reduction • Conduct investigations by working closely with CS and support functions in SLP and Ops • Meeting the weekly investigation targets and submitting investigation reports • Sharing RCAs and PTG initiatives on shrink and unmet goals

We value an inclusive environment where everyone’s different viewpoints help to achieve results. Financial advisors lead the branch team to serve clients and contribute to the firm's purpose. They deeply understand the client's goals and why they are important to accelerate trust and help them stay on track. Edward Jones helps you positively impact clients' lives and work together to achieve their long-term financial goals, enabling you to make a difference in your community.

A firm-provided branch office in the community

A support network that extends from your branch office to your region to the home office – You’ll work independently, but will have a team of thousands backing you every step of the way.

You can also expect…

No ceiling to your earning potential and growth, and your compensation is tied to the effort you put in

A compensation package that includes opportunities for commissions, profit sharing and incentive travel

The flexibility that you need to balance your personal and professional lives – the best of both worlds

A culture of continuous improvement and professional development

jobs.description: Job Description Summary: The Coca-Cola Company is evolving into a more digital-first, data-driven enterprise to fuel sustainable growth, increase speed to market, and unlock new sources of value. Rapid advances in data and AI create a unique opportunity to accelerate the KO system’s next chapter of growth. In LATAM, this ambition takes shape through our data vision for the 2030 Long-Range Plan: connecting our data assets across Consumer, Customer and Enterprise into one trusted, AI-ready intelligence ecosystem, and running the business on connected intelligence rather than isolated reports. This next phase moves us from early wins to scaled, end-to-end impact — powered by a growth engine that embeds data science and agentic AI into our most critical business domains. Success demands more than technology: it requires a product-centric operating model and a culture of experimentation, data fluency, and seamless partnership between business and digital teams. Role Overview The Coca-Cola Company is seeking a Senior Manager, Data Science and Agentic AI to design, build and scale the models and AI agents that turn LATAM’s data into decisions. Sitting within the LATAM Data & Analytics team, you will take priority use cases from experimentation to production — combining classic data science (predictive/prescriptive modeling) with modern agentic AI (LLM-powered assistants and multi-step agents) on top of our governed data foundations. You will build and operationalize AI agents such as data assistants , grounding them in trusted data and business logic so they reason reliably and safely. Working on the target stack (Microsoft Fabric/ OneLake , Azure AI Foundry, Azure ML, and our in-house AI platform), you will partner with data engineering, product and governance teams to ensure every model and agent is AI-ready, monitored and cost-controlled. This is a hands-on senior individual-contributor : deep enough to build, and senior enough to shape how we design, evaluate and scale agentic solutions across the OU. What You’ll Do for Us Data Science & Modeling Build predictive and prescriptive models (forecasting, elasticity, segmentation, next-best-action) that support revenue growth, commercial execution and enterprise decisions. Take use cases from PoC to production with sound experimentation design, feature engineering, validation, and clear measurement of business impact. Analyze large, complex datasets to surface trends, drivers, risks and optimization opportunities. Agentic AI (core) Design and build AI agents and copilots — LLM-powered assistants and multi-step/agentic workflows grounded in governed data and business logic. Apply modern GenAI patterns — RAG, prompt and context engineering, tool/function calling, orchestration and multi-agent design, with semantic/ontology grounding so agents reason over meaning, not raw tables. Operationalize agents on the target stack — Azure AI Foundry + Microsoft Fabric (with Azure ML and the Nexus AI platform), including deployment, versioning and integration into business workflows. Evaluate and harden agents for production — build eval sets and guardrails; monitor accuracy, hallucination, bias and model/agent drift; track token cost against per-use-case budgets. Embed Responsible AI and governance — align with the AI-Ready Dataset guidelines and T1/T2/T3 scoring from the AI LATAM Office, ensuring lineage, auditability and safe, compliant use. Collaboration, MLOps & Adoption Partner cross- functionally with Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain and Strategy to frame problems and land solutions that change decisions. Work with data engineering and governance to strengthen data accessibility, quality and AI-readiness, and to apply MLOps practices (CI/CD, monitoring, reproducibility). Translate technical results into business stories and clear recommendations for senior stakeholders. Champion data & AI fluency — coach analysts, share reusable patterns, and promote experimentation and evidence-based decision-making. Requirements & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree required in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Analytics or related field (Master’s a plus). 5+ years of experience in data science, machine learning or advanced analytics, including hands-on delivery of models into production. Practical experience building GenAI/agentic solutions — LLM applications, RAG, prompt/context engineering, tool calling and agent orchestration ( LangChain , Semantic Kernel, Azure AI Foundry or similar). Strong programming and ML foundations — Python (pandas, scikit-learn, and a modern deep-learning/LLM framework), SQL, and solid statistics/experimentation. Experience on cloud data & AI platforms — Azure preferred (Azure ML, Azure AI Foundry/OpenAI), plus Microsoft Fabric/Databricks; familiarity with MLOps and vector stores. Awareness of Responsible AI and governance — evaluation, guardrails, bias/drift monitoring, lineage and cost control; awareness of EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF as reference frameworks is a plus . Strong communication and business acumen — able to explain complex models and agents to technical and non-technical audiences and connect them to measurable outcomes. Collaboration in matrixed, global teams with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Familiarity with the Beverage/System landscape (RGM, Commercial, Revenue) is a plus. What We Can Do for You Purpose with impact. Our purpose is “TO REFRESH THE WORLD . MAKE A DIFFERENCE.” Your models and agents will directly shape how LATAM grows and decides. Build at the frontier. Work on live agentic AI (NSR Agent, BI Assistant, RGM assistants) on a modern Azure/Fabric/Foundry stack, in one of the richest data ecosystems in the System. Scale and network. Collaborate across a globally networked organization, with exposure to Global DTS, Europe and leading bottlers. Growth. Grow as a data science and agentic -AI leader as we scale from early wins to enterprise-wide impact. Skills: Location(s): Mexico City/Cities: Mexico Travel Required: 00% - 25% Relocation Provided: No Job Posting End Date: October 7, 2026 Our Purpose and Growth Culture: We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We act with a growth mindset, take an expansive approach to what’s possible and believe in continuous learning to improve our business and ourselves. We focus on four key behaviors – curious, empowered, inclusive and agile – and value how we work as much as what we achieve. We believe that our culture is one of the reasons our company continues to thrive after 130+ years. Visit Our Purpose and Vision to learn more about these behaviors and how you can bring them to life in your next role at Coca-Cola.

The Decision Systems Experimentation Platform team builds the platform and standards which let DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt experiment successfully across every side of the marketplace, from consumers and merchants to dashers. About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Seoul-based Public Policy expert to lead Anthropic’s policy engagement in South Korea. In this role, you will advance practical AI governance and support Anthropic’s commercial expansion by building strategic relationships with Korean government authorities, developing substantive policy positions and papers, and engaging in regular outreach to drive progress in AI policy and AI safety. You will draw upon established relationships with key policymakers and their staff to shape how Korea approaches AI regulation and safety during a critical period of governance development.

As part of this role, you will collaborate with a dynamic, geographically distributed policy team on a variety of projects, including analyzing policy proposals, drafting submissions to requests for public comment, planning and executing policy campaigns in Korea, and providing policy advice to technical colleagues. This is a foundational hire — you will be building Anthropic’s policy presence in Seoul from the ground up.

Key responsibilities

•

Conduct comprehensive mapping of key Korean AI policy stakeholders and build strategic relationships with government officials, think tank researchers, and civil society leaders across the national and, where appropriate, sub-national governmental levels

•

Brief a diverse set of policy and research actors looking to better understand AI safety and AI policy opportunities in the Korean context

•

Convene diverse stakeholders and speak at policy events such as research announcements, discussion panels, or workshops on AI safety topics

•

Analyze emerging legislation and develop Anthropic’s engagement strategy, including preparing substantive policy submissions and response documents

•

Support senior colleagues in external engagements by preparing meeting briefs and taking action on follow-up requests

•

Develop new programming and generate opportunities for Anthropic to regularly engage with Korean policymakers, think tanks, and non-profit organizations

•

Collaborate with policy and technical teams to translate Anthropic research into concrete policy proposals, stakeholder education, and thought leadership opportunities tailored to the Korean regulatory environment

•

Develop and amplify public submissions, responses to requests for information (RFI), and policy memos written by Anthropic to drive positive change in AI policy

•

Partner with non-profit organizations and academic researchers to publish discussion papers and policy memos on how to enable responsible AI research and development

•

Develop and execute a convening strategy, including workshops or panels that position Anthropic as a thought leader in AI safety and governance in South Korea

Minimum qualifications

•

Preferred 10+ years of professional experience in government, technology, legal, and/or other policy-relevant environments

•

Have a track record of effective, information-rich advocacy with Korean government authorities at the federal and/or state level

•

Have experience analyzing legislation and engaging in regulatory processes

•

Are energized by agency — you will be the first policy hire in Korea and will be building the operation from scratch

•

Enjoy drafting and executing complex policy campaigns that move the needle

•

Thrive when engaging with policymakers, civil society, and think tanks to translate complex technical topics into accessible and relevant information

•

Excel at translating high-level vision into executable operational plans

•

Have demonstrated an ability to quickly get up to speed on complex technical areas and policy dynamics

•

Are deeply curious about frontier technological research and are eager to work closely with technical colleagues to translate new discoveries into policy outcomes

Are fluent in Korean and English

Preferred qualifications

AI/technology industry experience (heavily preferred)

•

Experience working with international companies or organizations

Academic or think tank background in AI policy or related fields

Experience in both government and private sector roles

Familiarity with intelligence and security cooperation frameworks

Logistics

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. jobs.description: AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset. We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to join our team that is building revolutionary enterprise applications that leverage Amazon's extensive operational expertise to help millions of companies worldwide manage their day-to-day supply chain operations. Our mission is to accelerate our customers' businesses through intuitive differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring supply chain challenges. We blend strategic vision with curiosity and Amazon's real-world experience to build opinionated turnkey solutions that make the 'buy versus build' decision a no-brainer for our customers. If you're passionate about creating enterprise-grade applications that combine Amazon's operational excellence with technology we want to hear from you. As a key member of our team you will develop GenAI/Agentic AI solutions that help millions of companies worldwide optimize their supply chain operations. We operate like a startup within AWS offering you the opportunity to tackle unprecedented challenges at global scale while working with state-of-the-art technologies. If you're passionate about building intuitive scalable solutions and want to shape the future of supply chain management while working in a fast-paced collaborative environment we want to hear from you. This role offers unique opportunities to innovate influence architecture decisions and make significant impacts through machine learning technologies all while having the backing of AWS extensive resources. Key job responsibilities • : As a Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) you will define own and drive technical programs that span multiple engineering/science teams and organizational boundaries. You will partner with product management and technical leadership to identify company-wide opportunities for demand planning needs, improve product offerings, identify new areas of investment, and work to align other group's engineering roadmaps to deliver on these opportunities and optimize delivery outcomes. As a technical leader you will influence strategy and outcomes across different Amazon organizations. • This role is inherently cross-functional and requires a strong ability to communicate influence and earn the trust of software engineers technical and business leadership. About the team Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud. Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
